title: DuckDB connector config
description: The OPAQUE `config:` block for mac.connector.duckdb (record §5.3). MAC never reads a key inside it; this file is the authority that validates it, and §6.3's mount tier applies it with ZERO imports of the connector class. Note what is NOT here: no region, no workgroup, no catalog, no account, no output location. A block with zero key overlap with the Athena connector's is the demonstration that the envelope is not engine-shaped.

database.description: Path to the DuckDB database file, RELATIVE TO THE BUNDLE ROOT. A shipped bundle declares a relative path; an absolute path is a deployment fact and belongs in the out-of-band overlay (connection.local.yaml / $DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG), which is gitignored for that reason.

read_only.description: Open the database read-only. Defaults to TRUE: §4.5 requires that a published, shipped bundle can never be used to write, and a default that has to be set correctly in order to be safe is a default that will be wrong in some bundle.
